summary: Signed clearway on a new interchange; no parking and nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Ramps and viaduct edge, no pull-out

best_section.where: Moggill Road interchange, north kerb of the viaduct approach

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 31 m or more away, but the spot is open to traffic on all sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Line follows ramp and barrier edges against live lanes; no verge or bay.
drivers.traffic: Busy interchange with multiple lanes and turning movements.
drivers.convention: Clearway with tow-away; no cars parked along the kerb.

flags: Road layout changed since the QLD image (construction then)
sun_shade: Open to sun; no tree cover.
